data.long_meaning: The name Kritarth is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two words: Krta and Arth. Krta means 'done' and Arth means 'value, worth, or meaning'. This name implies that a person named Kritarth has been judged or criticized, and their worth or meaning has been determined. This name may be given to a child who was born under challenging circumstances or to one who has overcome significant obstacles.
